## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Industrials and Utilities are showing leadership while Technology is weak, and Top 5 performers are spread across Energy/Tech/Industrials/Utilities (Leadership: Broad).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%), EXC ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +5.36%). Industrials strong: DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%), GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%), AAPL in CORRECTION (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%), NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%). Materials and Financials also soft with sector 1W returns negative (Materials: DOW in CORRECTION (1W: -7.68% | 1M: +18.10%), Financials: V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.91%)).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%), DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%), NOW in RECOVERY (1W: +6.75% | 1M: -14.38%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); favors cyclical/utility exposure.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC in CORRECTION (1W: -5.83% | 1M: +12.35%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.06% | 1M: -11.54%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -21.18%), RCL in CORRECTION (1W: -7.01% | 1M: +14.94%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -20.28%). Weakness concentrated in select Tech/Services names and travel-related cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: OXY (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%), AMAT (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +16.21%), DE (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%), VST (1W: +7.71% | 1M: +10.01%), GE (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA and others show 1W vs 1M mismatch) — watch for trend break and tactical opportunities rather than broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure with mixed pullbacks and short-term bounces; sector 1W: -1.85% (24 stocks). Representative names: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -12.33%), AAPL in CORRECTION (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%), NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft on the week (1W: -1.59% | 20 stocks) and lack clear leadership; JPM in CORRECTION (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +1.75%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.91%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.16%). Rotation favoring Industrials/Energy limits Financials’ upside for now.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is marginally positive (1W: +0.22% | 17 stocks) with defensive names showing strength; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +13.15%), UNH in RECOVERY (1W: +3.95% | 1M: -14.33%), LLY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.57%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and selective defensives: prefer Industrials and Energy exposure given leaders like DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +30.14%) and OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%). Reduce exposure to large-cap Tech where many names are in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND and monitor Major Divergence for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%) on order flow and dividend chatter, AMZN in RECOVERY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -11.32%) on retail-share milestones, LLY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.57%) after trial data. BEARISH: BA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.14%) on negative headlines, WMT in CORRECTION (1W: -3.03% | 1M: +5.19%) after weak outlook.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials and Utilities (momentum and positive headlines). BEARISH: Technology and Materials until large-cap divergences resolve.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AAPL in CORRECTION (1W: -5.42% | 1M: +5.73%) for 1W follow-through below this week’s lows as a trigger to reduce exposure; NVDA in CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +5.52%) holds short-term support for tech stability; JPM in CORRECTION (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +1.75%) needs weekly follow-through to confirm cyclical rotation; OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.08% | 1M: +21.99%) sustaining gains confirms Energy strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GE (+65): United GEnx engine order and dividend update; price confirming — GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +7.17%). AMZN (+60): annual sales milestone; price in RECOVERY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -11.32%) — short-term confirmation, longer-term watch. LLY (+60): positive trial data in lung cancer; LLY in RECOVERY (1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.57%) — sentiment aligns with recent uptick.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-85): negative program-level headlines and scrutiny; BA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -6.14%) — sentiment confirmed by price. WMT (-45): weak outlook under new CEO; WMT in CORRECTION (1W: -3.03% | 1M: +5.19%) — sentiment diverging from 1M strength, monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style favored. DE, AMAT, OXY, VST showing relative strength (DE ABOVE TREND; AMAT ABOVE TREND; OXY ABOVE TREND; VST ABOVE TREND). Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE among big Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) and mixed sentiment signals that warrant waiting for trend confirmation.
